meta.promptText: Which brand's kurta sets should I buy for women online in India?

response.text:
If you’re shopping for **women’s kurta sets online in India**, these are the brands I’d shortlist:

| Brand | Best for | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **BIBA** | Everyday + festive | ⭐ Best all-rounder |
| **W for Woman** | Office / polished looks | ⭐ Best for workwear |
| **Libas** | Trendy, affordable sets | ⭐ Best value |
| **Aurelia** | Comfortable everyday + occasion | ⭐ Great versatility |
| **Fabindia** | Natural fabrics, classic styles | ⭐ Premium/timeless |
| **Soch** | Dressier ethnicwear | ⭐ Festive & occasion |
| **Rangriti** | Budget-friendly everyday wear | ⭐ Affordable |


Recent comparisons particularly favor **W for Woman for polished versatility, BIBA for practical everyday cotton, Aurelia for dressier occasions, and Fabindia for timeless/artisanal styles**. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top 3

**1. BIBA — safest overall choice**  
If you want one brand without overthinking it, I'd start here. Their cotton printed sets work well for regular wear, while they also have embroidered and festive options. [www.biba.in](https://www.biba.in/kurta-sets/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Biba Women's Floral Print Straight Kurta Set]()
*₹2,159*

**2. Libas — best if you want stylish sets around ₹1,000–₹2,500**  
Libas has a particularly broad range of printed, straight, A-line and embroidered sets, making it a good choice if you want something fashionable without spending too much. Current online examples include sets around ₹1,800–₹2,500. [zoutons.com](https://zoutons.com/news/myntra-kurta-sets-under-2000-trending-styles-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Libas Women's Floral Embroidered Straight Suit Set]()
*₹1,809*

**3. W for Woman — best for office**  
Go with W if you want kurtas that look **smart, structured and contemporary**, rather than very traditional. A recent wear-test rated W particularly highly for office-ready versatility. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Also worth considering

- **Aurelia:** excellent middle ground between everyday comfort and dressier ethnicwear. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Fabindia:** choose this if fabric, understated design and a more premium feel matter more than following trends.
- **Soch:** better when you want something more visibly festive or occasion-oriented.
- **Rangriti:** good for building a larger everyday wardrobe on a budget.

**If I were buying 5 sets:** I'd do **2 BIBA + 2 Libas + 1 W for Woman**. That gives you everyday cotton, officewear and a couple of slightly dressier options.

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. under ₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000), age range, and whether you want cotton or festive**, I can narrow it down to **10 specific kurta sets currently worth buying online**.
